note: TEST BESTIARY — throwaway by design. Every id begins `test.`, every display name begins "TEST — ", every row carries test:true. Delete this one file and nothing else in the project changes. To promote one to real content, copy the row, drop the test flag, and rename the id.

blocked.name: TEST — Standing Aura (BLOCKED)
blocked.needs: the `aura` hook — a standing property with a radius, checked continuously
blocked.why: Every aura above is faked as onActivationEnd, so it pulses once per activation instead of being TRUE while you stand there. A hero who walks in and out mid-activation is untouched. 28 content entries carry a real aura; this is the gap.

blocked.name: TEST — Opener (BLOCKED)
blocked.why: 36 content entries fire at startOfBattle. Nothing enemy-side can currently deploy, buff itself, or summon on turn zero.

blocked.name: TEST — Riposte (BLOCKED)
blocked.why: Fires on the DEFENDER when its Dodge is why the attack missed. The Flicker at 40 Dodge is the fixture waiting for it. See engine/COMBAT-SEQUENCE.md #onDodge.

blocked.name: TEST — Slayer (BLOCKED)
blocked.why: "+2 damage against undead" cannot be expressed. 43 content entries need it. See engine/COMBAT-SEQUENCE.md #Conditional-on-the-target.

blocked.why: TERRAIN.BURNING and TERRAIN.POISONED exist as constants in types.ts and nothing writes them. A hex that is set burning must still be burning next Turn.
